topic: AI agents (mostly Claude) connected to real cars through a cable

entries.title: 1994 Jeep Cherokee ECU reverse-engineered and rewritten with Claude Code + Codex over a $3 Arduino
entries.outcome: Live ECU reads, drive logging, full program copy, ran its own code, passed California smog test
entries.notable: Claude offered to run the fuel pump and primed the rail for ~10s before being told to stop
entries.critique: A lean tune raises NOx; adding fuel moves toward lambda and reduces NOx while raising CO/HC. Likely masked a mechanical fault rather than fixing it.

entries.title: BMW iDrive 7/8 head unit rooted over one ENET cable, then Doom 3 on the dash
entries.outcome: Root SSH, app store on the dash, Waze on the cluster and HUD, YouTube, browser, live engine data, Doom

ecosystem.note: debug image flash over ENET, open sourced 2026-10-22
CarPlay/AndroidAuto maps on cluster and HUD, created 2026-10-31, 377 stars

entries.scope_note: Head unit only. Does not touch engine, brakes or airbags. Refuses to flash until a coding backup exists.

entries.title: Frontier models drive a real Toyota Corolla through a cone course via MCP tools
entries.outcome: Claude reached 45% of a 127 m course; GPT-6 Astra finished in 5:22

entries.title: Claude runs BMW ISTA+ headlessly and walks to the faulty component
entries.outcome: Read a stored charge-pressure fault, pulled BMW's test plan as text, identified the part; fault gone after replacement

entries.title: AI decodes BMW CAN, ESP32 replaces the shifter, same trick for an i8 engine swap
entries.outcome: Shifter replaced by an ESP32; i8 swap CAN signals decoded; touchscreen steering wheel with paddle shifters

entries.title: A $35 Mini VCI cable becomes a J2534 MCP server for Toyota and Lexus
entries.outcome: ISO15765 CAN channels, UDS + OBD-II, Toyota enhanced mode 0x21 ReadDataByLocalIdentifier, 12,000+ DTCs across 33 brands

entries.title: AI clones a pickup ECU off an eBay spare and hunts the immobilizer
entries.outcome: Full read and write of a spare ECU including VIN; ~15 KB not copyable, narrowed to nine bytes in three slots

entries.title: Four Claude Code agents rendering on the car's centre screen, in a dealership
hardware: CarPlay AI box over USB (Ottocast / Carlinkit Tbox class)
entries.outcome: Claimed CarPlay reverse engineering and a live multi-agent dashboard on the car screen
entries.caveat: Engagement-driven posts, unverified beyond the posts themselves

entries.title: Proprietary CAN signals decoded into DBC files in minutes
entries.outcome: Speed, RPM and gauge signals decoded into DBC using OBD-II, vision OCR or human input as reference

entries.title: Free macOS app reads every BMW ECU over an ENET cable, with MCP for Claude
entries.outcome: Every control unit's faults with hints, live engine data against norms, guided engine check, read-only by design

Ground truth beats model quality for CAN reverse engineering
The cable is the moat, not the model
